reference_variant: Retained passing references and reviewed SDF edge-quality references
acceptance: User permits algorithm updates and small visual differences when measurable and visual quality is maintained. Agent reviewed H/independent-coverage comparisons and representative face, outline, shadow, bitmap, rich-text, Latin/Arabic captures. All 48 independent quality cases and all 392 native captures passed before reference acceptance.
policy: 98% native likeness catches unreviewed changes. Pixel likeness to 1.13.1 is informational; both versions are measured against independent pixel-area coverage, with explicit small-difference budgets. Filter-width tests specify the selected kernel rather than universally ranking antialiasing algorithms.
bob: Dedicated font-library generators load fixtures directly. Bob compiler/native-renderer and editor integration tests run separately.
reference_encoding_note: Unchanged references are retained from retained_reference_source. Other PNGs were captured with the 64/255 SDF encoding; input_hashes and binaries describe those captures. The final 0.25 encoding and direct bitmap coverage are tested against this mixed baseline.
